verdict.consequence: The flip does not generalise beyond Phase 0's isomer-driven pairs. The premise is dead at this budget; write up the null.

criterion_A_structural_note.note: Two facts, both recorded, neither used to alter the rule. (1) STRUCTURAL: the confirmation set admits at most 1 cluster pair(s) with >=2 oracles (bioactivity holds 1 held-out oracle, so every pair involving it is 'insufficient'), while the frozen threshold requires 2 confirmed pairs -- so the threshold could not have been met by any data. (2) EMPIRICAL: the pair that WAS testable (mpo vs similarity) was tested and did not confirm on any backbone -- its bootstrap CI spans zero and its replication rate is far below the pre-registered 0.95. Criterion A therefore also fails on the evidence, so no amendment of min_pairs could have changed this verdict.
